description: A viral infection that attacks your respiratory system.
prevention: Annual flu vaccine and good hygiene.
treatment_action: Rest, fluids, and antiviral medications in some cases.

description: A common sleep disorder that can make it hard to fall asleep, hard to stay asleep, or cause you to wake up too early.
causes: Stress, poor sleep habits, mental health disorders, or medical conditions.
prevention: Consistent sleep schedule, stay active, and avoid caffeine/alcohol late in the day.
treatment_action: Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT-I) and lifestyle changes.
complications: Lower performance, slowed reaction time, and increased risk of long-term diseases.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A condition in which blood lacks adequate healthy red blood cells due to insufficient iron.
causes: Blood loss, lack of iron in diet, or inability to absorb iron.
symptoms: Chest pain or shortness of breath
prevention: Eat iron-rich foods and vitamin C to help absorption.
treatment_action: Iron supplements and treating the underlying cause of blood loss.
complications: Heart problems, pregnancy complications, and growth problems in children.
medical_disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

description: A common disorder that affects the large intestine.
causes: Muscle contractions in the intestine, nervous system abnormalities, and severe infections.
prevention: Manage stress and identify trigger foods.
treatment_action: Dietary changes, lifestyle adjustments, and medications.
complications: Poor quality of life and mood disorders.
